import json, pathlib, sys, time
p=pathlib.Path('reality/account.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
op=sys.argv[1]
d['applied_count'] += 1
d['operation_ids'].append(op)
p.write_text(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))+'\n')
barrier=pathlib.Path('reality/effect-applied-before-post.json')
barrier.write_text(json.dumps({'operation_id':op,'post_recorded':False}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))+'\n')
release=pathlib.Path('reality/controller-release')
while not release.exists():
    time.sleep(0.02)
pathlib.Path('reality/effect-post.json').write_text(json.dumps({'operation_id':op,'outcome':'ok'}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))+'\n')
print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))
